sourceTitle: The Mad Lover, a Tragi-Comedy The Works of Francis Beaumont and John Fletcher (3 of 10)
description: "The Mad Lover, a Tragi-Comedy" by Francis Beaumont and John Fletcher is a tragicomedy written between 1616-1619. The play explores melancholia and madness through the story of Memnon, a general suffering from depression over unrequited love.
